resources.string: Import your OpenClaw connection file, or enter its address and connection key manually. Keep OpenClaw running on your computer. The app will check the connection before you start sharing.
This changes the receiver, key or selected apps. Pending events to clear: %1$d. Cancel to keep the current sharing setup, or switch and clear them.
Your sharing choice is saved. After a restart and unlock, sharing resumes if it was on. Stop sharing keeps it off.
